note: JSON-LD written by the client rather than served with the document — increasingly common, since most CMS plugins and site generators inject it. The strongest signal the extractor has is invisible to a static fetch. Also carries non-ASCII characters (Yıldırım, İzmir) through a render, where a mangled name would be a different bug from a missing one.
